preparation.replacement_rule: none; technical preparation failures retained and stop for review

randomness: Original school-inclusive private capture/tie/Gtarget arithmetic; readiness school+stableID only. Two labels are stochastic-world repeats, not new schools or pure q randomness.

selection.criterion: H1/G36 fixed from completed D12 discovery; no validation reselection

footprint: Original12D slots and3G sites,12 point birds/site; no collision/avoidance; no added coverage
grid_scope: Encounter-grid sensitivity conditional on same20T coarse-prepared starts, not preparation convergence
resumption: Case-granularity only: completed sealed outcomes may be resumed without rerun; partial/unsealed cases stop for technical review, no automatic retry
compact_outputs: Existing compressed npz trajectories at0.1T, gzip event logs, and exact receipts; no raw-bank duplication
